title: UPSRLM
fullName: Uttar Pradesh State Rural Livelihood Mission
subtitle: State-scale rural governance portals, offline-first field mobile apps, and real-time analytical data pipelines — everything engineered in one ecosystem.

projects.title: Training Management System (TMS)
projects.shortDesc: End-to-end React.js & Django MIS digitizing the entire rural training journey — from bottom-up Annual Action Planning (AAP) to biometric eKYC attendance and batch certification.
highlights: End-to-End Lifecycle Automation: Digitized the complete training workflow from bottom-up Annual Action Planning (AAP) to final batch certification.
Advanced Attendance Verification: Engineered Day-1 biometric eKYC and daily CSV punch file ingestion that automatically computes presence from valid IN/OUT logs.
Logistics & Infrastructure Management: Built Training Partner centre registration with GPS coordinates and mandatory media uploads verified before batch approval.

projects.title: Enterprise Sakhi Management System (EPSMS)
projects.shortDesc: Dual-platform web monitoring dashboard and lifecycle tracking system managing economic data and financial scorecards for 6.5 lakh rural women entrepreneurs.
highlights: Dual-Platform Architecture: Led development of the state-level React.js monitoring dashboard paired with the Udhyam Sakhi mobile field app.
Lifecycle Data Capture: Structured workflows across Existing Enterprise, New Enterprise, and No Enterprise stages.
Integrated Financial Tracking: Auto-calculation engines for Gross Profit and Annual Turnover across 6.5 lakh women entrepreneurs.

projects.title: Udhyam Sakhi Android App (CRP-EP)
projects.shortDesc: Offline-first React Native Android application enabling rural field cadres (CRP-EPs) to capture enterprise lifecycle data in low-bandwidth villages with deferred cloud sync.
highlights: Offline-First Rural Engineering: Implemented local queuing and deferred synchronization so field cadres never lose data in zero-connectivity zones.
Automated Field Calculations: Built-in Gross Profit and Annual Turnover calculators reduce manual entry errors during doorstep surveys.
Production Deployment: Published and actively utilized by field cadres on the Google Play Store.

projects.title: Lakhpati Didi Management System (LDMS)
projects.shortDesc: Outcome-focused monitoring framework tracking Potential Lakhpati Didis (PLDs) against multi-year Individual Entrepreneurship Plans with mandatory photographic evidence.
highlights: Outcome-Focused Framework: Transitioned mission tracking from simple activity logs to monitoring Potential Lakhpati Didis against 2–3 year Entrepreneurship Plans (AEP/VPRP).
Evidence-Based Accountability: Enforced mandatory photographic and documentary proof across training, finance, and mentoring touchpoints to eliminate verbal reporting traps.

projects.title: Power BI Analytical Dashboard Pipelines
projects.shortDesc: Automated data ingestion pipelines using Power BI Dataflows, DirectQuery, and native DAX measures — replacing fragmented manual Excel backends with real-time state scorecards.
highlights: Automated Data Pipelines: Engineered the transition from fragmented manual Excel sheets to automated ingestion via Power BI Dataflows and DirectQuery.
Advanced Analytical Infrastructure: Authored native DAX measures for real-time district/block scorecard calculations and rankings.

projects.title: UPPLD Aspirational Blocks Dashboard
projects.shortDesc: High-visibility executive monitoring dashboard tracking livelihood saturation, SHG credit linkage, and Lakhpati Didi progression across Uttar Pradesh's Aspirational Blocks.
highlights: Granular Administrative Drilldowns: Real-time KPI aggregation across State, District, Aspirational Block, Gram Panchayat, and Village levels.
Executive Decision Support: Built interactive visual scorecards for mission leadership reviews.

projects.title: Samuh Saathi App
projects.shortDesc: Dedicated mobile companion engineered for Self-Help Group (SHG) facilitators to streamline group meetings, member onboarding, and grassroots record digitization.
highlights: Grassroots Usability: Designed high-contrast, intuitive mobile workflows tailored for rural SHG sakhis and community cadres.
Seamless Backend Sync: Integrated directly with master beneficiary registries for instant member lookup.

projects.title: Mahila Udhyami Credit Card Yojana App
projects.shortDesc: Android application digitizing credit card applications, eligibility verification, and bank linkage tracking for rural women entrepreneurs under the MCCY scheme.
highlights: End-to-End Credit Application Flow: Simplified application capture, document verification, and status tracking for rural women entrepreneurs.
Bank Linkage Visibility: Transparent stage-by-stage tracking from block submission to branch sanction.

projects.title: Beneficiary Management System (BMS)
projects.shortDesc: The authoritative 3NF MySQL 8.x master reference layer synchronizing NRLM LokOS beneficiary data with jurisdiction-based RBAC across Block, District, and State hierarchies.
highlights: Foundational Master Layer: Consolidated fragmented mission records into a normalized MySQL 8.x (3NF) database serving as the Single Version of Truth.
NRLM LokOS API Synchronization: Engineered secure API consumers to fetch and filter active SHG members from MasterData and Production servers.
Jurisdiction-Based Governance: Implemented strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) scoping data visibility across Block, District, and State hierarchies.
